questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with formal register and appropriate use of subjunctive mood.
options: I suggest that he takes his time to consider the matter.
I suggest that he should take his time to consider the matter.
I suggest that he taking his time to consider the matter.
I suggest that he takes his time to consider the matter.
questions.answer: I suggest that he takes his time to consider the matter.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates the use of ellipsis in formal English?
options: The committee members agreed that the proposal was acceptable, but they were not unanimous.
The committee members agreed that the proposal was acceptable, but not unanimous.
The committee members agreed that the proposal was acceptable, but the committee was not unanimous.
The committee members agreed that the proposal was acceptable, but the members were not unanimous.
questions.answer: The committee members agreed that the proposal was acceptable, but not unanimous.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct and most appropriate sentence for a formal report, using inversion for emphasis.
options: Never before has such a proposal been considered by this committee.
Never before has been considered such a proposal by this committee.
Never before have been considered such a proposal by this committee.
Never before have such a proposal been considered by this committee.
questions.answer: Never before has such a proposal been considered by this committee.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location in the given context?
options: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the manuscript.
It was the old library where the historian discovered the manuscript.
It was in the old library that the historian discovered the manuscript.
It was the old library that the historian discovered the manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the manuscript.

questions.question: Identify the correct form of the conditional sentence that accurately expresses a hypothetical situation in a formal context.
options: If the committee had known about the budget cuts, they would have requested additional funding.
If the committee had known about the budget cuts, they would request additional funding.
If the committee had known about the budget cuts, they would have requested additional funding.
If the committee had known about the budget cuts, they will request additional funding.
questions.answer: If the committee had known about the budget cuts, they would have requested additional funding.
